entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted SDK or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent provider organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered loading system to reduce token usage. It archives sessions as editable Markdown files and demonstrated a 43-49% task-completion gain over baselines in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: A self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory by distilling session lessons into searchable records. It builds these graphs from text, code, and conversations using local extraction models that do not require LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction from sources like video and code while offering byte-level deduplication and auto-updating user profiles.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This agent brain supports keyword retrieval, semantic search, and synthesis with citations through a typed knowledge graph. It exposes memory to agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over local connections or Tailscale.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system focused on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark. it supports over 25 LLM providers and offers client implementations in Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: The upstream library for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper, this FastAPI-based server enables the creation of stateful agents with Python and TypeScript SDKs. It supports managed or Docker-based deployments and integrates with MCP and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to achieve sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It includes episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP or a Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to provide vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that uses filesystem-first artifacts like playbooks and context bundles to assist agents with complex tasks. It is available as a CLI or library and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that employs a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to ensure no messages are lost. It uses a SQLite store and provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep for recovering specific details.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 34 different coding agents to enable search across months of past sessions. It wires MCP recall into detected agents for session-start retrieval and redacts keys and tokens during indexing.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted memory backend that provides private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent systems. It utilizes BM25 and local embeddings for hybrid retrieval and provides MCP server integration for tool portability.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian, achieving 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy in benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining vector search and BM25, integrating via plugins, Claude Code hooks, and MCP.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based memory system using a SQLite-backed five-tier hierarchical schema with FTS5 search. It avoids vector databases and embedding models entirely, offering a plugin family that includes a Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes long context LLM inference through text and multimodal context reordering for prefix-cache sharing. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other engines to provide deduplication, reordering, and cache-aware scheduling.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded Hermes plugin featuring explainable retrieval where every recall includes a why_retrieved tag. It provides contradiction tracking, resolution primitives, and a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as Markdown files with frontmatter. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates via host-specific plugins and MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: A proactive memory CLI that maintains agent-driven wikis featuring citations, provenance, and links. It uses SQLite for storage with rebuildable index projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses a local-first stack with GGUF models, SQLite-vec, and an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack for Hermes Agent that integrates MemPalace, Graphiti, and Hindsight into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using Chroma, Kuzu, and SQLite to provide the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet per query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking via MCP-native integration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores durable context in plain Markdown for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and support for immediate event deletion. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK and MCP server that enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments. It supports USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families without requiring a backend or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate capability routing. It offers tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal, supported by automatic tool-OKF generation via detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable caching.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and supports LLM-callable tools for structured models.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers long-term memory with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project provides 17 specialized tools for Hermes agents to manage memory through knowledge graph traversal and hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression, enabling structured long-term knowledge retrieval.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based utility focuses on memory hygiene by using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting facts within markdown files. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review and utilizes a local git repository to track or revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning by applying TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles to software development. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured methodology for agentic software engineering.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts through a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtime via the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs into formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a standardized foundation for cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It includes a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout adjustments.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It features a master router and connector skills to manage escrow, verification, and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process for verification. It offers five optional voice profiles and supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or user accounts. The skills are designed for immediate use across various assistants including Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe support for agentskills.io using remote registries via Git and S3 sources. It provides sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite or Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production and automation in Portuguese. It supports integrations with messaging platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports Chainlink services like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, and installs via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX image and video generation. The suite includes eight specialist skills and supports polling and webhooks for BFL API tasks.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills with instructions linked to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting new skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language into reviewable files using a deterministic compiler. It provides integrity verification for execution traces and supports multiple AI model providers.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills with a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification, this project serves as a centralized hub for browsing and installing community skills. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token consumption and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling, habits, and study blocks. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like semgrep and bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram, supporting 97 different languages. It claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompt quality across five specific dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Go, and Rust. It incorporates a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent task state management and multi-story task decomposition.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project adds persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code, enabling worktree recovery and multi-session reconciliation. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides tools for skill scaffolding and eval auditing.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to add reproducible demo GIFs to repositories by generating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, web apps, and libraries, ensuring output files are optimized to stay under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while validating them against runtime-specific profiles. It monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift and uses CI-friendly exit codes to prevent broken deployments.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library without external daemons.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for content creation workflows, including an E-commerce Material Studio and structured data extraction.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages environment-specific path syntax and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures deterministic file routing and runtime compatibility without requiring new software installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, supported by a workspace Postgres database and scheduled tasks. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and is compatible with agentskills.io standards.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent ecosystems for handling monetized web resources.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for certificate verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables users to earn or pay USDC on the Base network for support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It facilitates listing bounties and buying context, with payments automatically distributed upon human approval of a winning answer.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for structured web data extraction across 31 platforms. It utilizes a hosted MCP server to support clients including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests while producing structured analysis that includes core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is designed to manage payment-required states for paid APIs by detecting HTTP signals during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing project data. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure the agent accesses up-to-date information.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a Terminal User Interface for visualization and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLIs directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance to Hermes Agent and other AI providers through specialized MCP servers. It assists in building user interfaces by integrating design expertise directly into the agent's prompting workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to handle the full lifecycle of building and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It features 36 distinct skills for tasks like deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art banners. It uses a YAML-based configuration system to modify visual elements like spinners and banner colors.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce through Solana-based payments in USDC and SOL.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run without external processes or OAuth. It specifically includes MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It enables persistent memory across platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that flags ambiguous tools and schema mismatches in AI agent configurations and system prompts. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and generates SARIF reports for integration into CI pipelines and GitHub Code Scanning.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup integrates Hermes Agent with RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through optimized CLI workflows. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining custom instructions and tools specific to individual directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides an automated installation for the Hermes Agent stack and 12 supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both zero-token passive analysis and active probing modes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project enables a deterministic, zero-network local runtime for Hermes Agent focused on executing business contracts and offer-previews. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes-voice adds a fully local, offline voice interface to the agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. The system features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This plugin adds multi-dimensional memory storage and semantic search capabilities to Hermes Agent via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for managing memory entries.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling configurations of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools. It enables one-click switching between different API providers to streamline agent operations.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for Hermes Agent. It facilitates remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This lightweight interface runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations without requiring build steps or bundlers. It features a three-panel layout designed for managing sessions, chat, and file browsing from web or mobile browsers.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app provides a streaming chat UI with markdown support and token usage tracking for local or remote Hermes Agent connections. It includes dedicated management tools for 14 toolsets, memory systems, and environment profiles.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes-studio is a web dashboard that offers unified configuration for 10 communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Slack. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics for multiple runtimes.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, and an inspector panel for managing Hermes Agent. It supports a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted server environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It includes specialized native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside memory management tools.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes for site-aware drafting. It features multi-agent thread synchronization and intelligent tab-scoping controls across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via a hermes-webui server. It provides mobile management for scheduled tasks and skills, featuring real-time chat streaming with tool-call details.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while monitoring live code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines. It features a control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and visualizes real-time tool calls during chat sessions.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that indexes local agent histories to enable searching through prompts, tool calls, and command outputs. It functions as a cockpit for tracking per-session token burn and estimated API costs without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA operates as a Telegram Mini App, supporting background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with file attachment support and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop environment runs via portable Python and Node.js without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI image creation, supported by a built-in workflow engine for multi-step pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes dedicated management tools for tracking tasks, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories alongside read-only environment variable monitoring.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for installing skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching during streaming chat sessions.
